more_beautiful.reason: A looks finished and holds together: warm cream and rust colours, heavy slab-serif headlines with clear hierarchy, a tilted luggage-tag date card and well-made form controls; B is clean but sparse, with empty half-columns at desktop width, a clashing mint/grey/mustard/magenta palette and browser-default radios and inputs.

less_generic.reason: B carries one idea, the ticket, through its stand-in wordmark ('Repair cafe | 1st Saturday' stub), the tear-off time-slot tickets and the 'Get your ticket' button, and its headline with the highlighted date reads like the cafe's own notice; A has a nice repair tag but otherwise follows the stock AI landing-page recipe (small-caps eyebrow, two-tone headline, icon cards in tinted squares, 1-2-3 'How it works', dark three-column footer).
